status: PLAN at $0 for the maintainer's review: no suite built, frozen or scored
decided_by: maintainer 2026-11-04 (review of a143b7ed), section 3: 1,063 / 1,800 accepted as a real measurement (29 tasks exhausted, 11 episodes admitted); prepare an independent, versioned evaluation plan with the same KL, scored-position and domain-aggregation definitions and frozen shared inputs; never marked as meeting the quota; any identity or protocol change bound separately

weights._: pooled over positions inside the tool sub-type (DistortionSums merge), unweighted over sub-types and domains (aadistill.initialization.statistics.contribution.domain_balanced_score); the other tool categories at their quotas (whole-episode overshoot moves these by a little)

uncertainty.unit: the episode: 1,063 positions are NOT 1,063 independent observations; the cell's KL is a ratio (sum of position KL / positions) over 11 clusters, four of which carry 78.7% of the positions
uncertainty.method: a delete-one-episode jackknife of the cell's position-weighted KL (and of its contribution to each objective), t with n - 1 = 10 degrees of freedom; the Kish effective count is reported beside it; no normal approximation over positions
uncertainty.registered_comparison: at the registered 1,800 positions with episodes like these (about 97 positions each) the cell would hold about 19 episodes; its standard error is expected to be about sqrt(19/11) = 1.3x larger here, more where the largest episodes dominate

decision_rule.what: a REPORTING rule beside every ranking that reads this suite; the ranking itself is unchanged
report: each objective as defined (equal-domain mean, worst domain, critical-token KL)
each objective with this cell left out (the tool sub-type pooled over the other six categories' positions; nothing else reweighted)
for the Top-1 against each state it is compared with (the Pareto front and the runner-up), the cell's contribution to their difference with its jackknife 90% interval
decision_rule.flag: SENSITIVE_TO_THE_LIMITED_CELL when leaving the cell out changes the Top-1 or the Pareto front, or when the Top-1's margin on an objective is within that interval of the cell's contribution; a flagged decision is reported as such, never re-decided by dropping the cell

follow_up_validation: re-score the retained Pareto front on a later suite version with full coverage when a compliant, admitted source supplies it (the search keeps the front's states; re-scoring is a forward pass, not a new search)
the trained students' formal measurement reads eval-set-1 (P10.3), where tool calling is reported as its own unit; it never selects a state
closed-loop tool success belongs to a registered tool evaluation (eval-set-2), not to teacher-forced KL

identity.differs_from_the_registered: state_eval_hybrid@v2 requires each category's share of 12,000 positions per mode and >= 5 tasks; on this pool it is not realizable and stays PENDING, never re-labelled. @v2-lc1 has its own items file, manifest, content sha256 and a coverage declaration naming this cell, its target, its realized positions, tasks and episodes and the status LIMITED_COVERAGE (never REACHED); every other cell meets the v2 rule or the suite does not freeze
unchanged: teacher-forced KL against the root teacher, scored positions, the domain aggregation
the critical groups (tool_call_open / tool_call_close added in both modes) and their 50:50
the forward context (Stage-1 packing) and the measurement protocol
identity.not_used: bounded_plan.approved_shortfalls (no SHORTFALL is approved by this plan)
identity.binding: a separate maintainer decision registers @v2-lc1; only then does freeze_state_eval gain a declared limited-coverage cell (a small code path), and every search that reads it names it

at_risk_rule: monitored in the hybrid session: such a cell runs to its bound; a cell that ends short is reported with its realized positions and tasks (SHORTFALL_EXHAUSTED) and handled by the existing mechanism -- nothing is pre-approved
